# Third party files in this folder

| Files | Project | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `maplibre-gl.mjs`, `maplibre-gl-worker.mjs`, `maplibre-gl-shared.mjs`, `maplibre-gl.css` | [MapLibre GL JS](https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js) | 6.18.0 | BSD 3 Clause, see `maplibre-gl.LICENSE.txt` |
| `pmtiles.js` | [PMTiles](https://github.com/protomaps/PMTiles) | 4.5.0 | BSD 3 Clause, see `pmtiles.LICENSE.txt` |
| `../map-light.json`, `../map-dark.json` | Generated with [Protomaps basemaps](https://github.com/protomaps/basemaps) | 5.7.2 | BSD 3 Clause, see `protomaps-basemaps.LICENSE.md` |
| `fonts/overpass-*.woff2` | [Overpass](https://github.com/RedHatOfficial/Overpass) via Fontsource | variable | SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `fonts/overpass.LICENSE.txt` |

These files are unmodified copies from the published packages, kept here so the dashboard works with no network.
